name: Secret scan
summary: Scan text for secrets, API keys, passwords
author: friday-core
description: Scans pasted text, config or code for private keys, cloud and AI provider keys, GitHub and Slack tokens, bearer tokens, JWTs, passwords in URLs and credential assignments, plus long random-looking strings. Shows line numbers and a masked preview, never the full secret, and returns a redacted copy. A pattern check, not a guarantee: a real exposed key must still be revoked and rotated.
